simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חֲזִיז (H2385) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: חֲזִיז (chăzîyz) means a flash of lightning First listed occurrence: Job 28 26.

definitions.full: H2385. chaziz [ חֲזִיז ] noun [masculine] thunder-bolt, lightning flash (Late Hebrew חֲזִיז ; Aramaic חֲזִיזָא shining cloud ) — only construct חֲזִיז and plural חֲזִיזִים ; קֹלוֺת לַחֲזִיז וְדֶרֶךְ Job 28:26 and a way for thunder-bolts = 38:25 ; ׳י חֲזִיזִים עשֶֹׁה Zech 10:1 (|| גֶּשֶׁם מְטַרֿ ).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to glare;
